task_description: Unit names ending in a sibilant pluralize wrongly on catalogue labels: a quantity of boxes renders as "3 boxs". Words ending in s, x, z, ch or sh take -es rather than -s. This is a general rule of English and holds for every such word, not only the one the failing test happens to name.
